source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.28
text: Harvesting guidance for seed-production fields: harvest at the correct maturity window — harvesting too early reduces grain quality/fill, while harvesting too late risks lodging and shattering losses that reduce both yield and seed quality. Producers are cautioned to watch for and manage lodging risk in the run-up to harvest, since lodged plants are harder to harvest cleanly and can mix with soil/debris or sprout prematurely. Fields should be reasonably dry (not waterlogged) at harvest time to allow clean cutting and handling. Grain moisture content at the time of cutting/harvest should be below 18%; harvested paddy is bundled/stooked and later threshed.
